client_timeout_note: Fault delay_response uses 10.0s hold; prior PR#5 renew delay showed Database(timed out) within ~2s.

enqueue_boundary.observed: Creating the retry task is one atomic EVALSHA enqueue script (HSETNX data + meta + scheduled|active + signal).
enqueue_boundary.worker_followup_commands: After a successful enqueue reply the worker also DELs delivery:{message}:{retries} and later runs handle_results/finish for A. Those are separate Redis ops. Losing the enqueue reply closes the proxy client socket, so follow-ups on that connection do not run. Do not call a dropped-reply case 'enqueue fully applied' for the whole retry path — only the enqueue script itself is atomic.
